headline.text: L3 truffle line guillotine belt stopped *twice* for buildup — maintenance flagged worn scrapers and peeling belt at shift end

per_plant_summary.L1: S4 ran most of the shift after clearing early maintenance issues on back-end equipment and a 55-minute salt contamination hold. S2 and S3 had minor kitchen and equipment flags. S3 hosted the Heath Cluster trial startup in the afternoon.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 and ML3 ran with brief stops for a demolder jam and CIL intervention, both under 10 minutes. FFS had a gusset jam mid-shift that cleared quickly, then went down again at 13:11 for blade cleaning with no restart logged by window close.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 cleared an early ingredient pump clog and tension issue but TG5 fought linked bars all day — tech adjusted upper bracket at 15:47. Truffle line's guillotine belt stopped at 11:03 and again at 15:11; second stop revealed worn scrapers and a peeling belt still in progress at window end.

notes.text: Heath Cluster trial ran from mid-morning through early afternoon with marshmallow deposit performing well per Katya at 10:49.
Chocolate adjustments logged for second shift on ML2 and ML3 at shift start.
ML4 brought centerline violations from 49 at shift start down to 22 by end of first shift after WDS adjustments.

resolved.title: Excess salt detected on S4 conveyor belt
resolved.summary: FSQA detected excess salt on the conveyor at 10:47, production stopped and all affected caramel removed from the line.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:25 — "All caramel containing excess salt was removed from the line. Production resumed once the caramel was confirmed to be within specifications" (Diana Vazquez).

resolved.title: S4 back-end equipment down on wrong parameter setting
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 08:39 because back of line had problems; maintenance found PG 303 set to 16 when it should be 18 and corrected it.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:22 — "We are back up and running" after maintenance adjusted PG 303 to correct setting (Karla Uribe).

resolved.title: Two soap dispensers in L1 not working
resolved.summary: Operators reported two soap dispensers down; sanitation checked and found one needed batteries, the other needed full replacement.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:35 — "One dispenser was replaced, and the bottle was changed on the other one because the battery was not working. All dispensers were left operational and in use" (Estarli Ermisz).

resolved.title: ML2 molding jam in demolder
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 07:09 for a molding jam blocking the demolder; operators cleared it and restarted within 9 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:18 — "The line is running back" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: FFS hose jammed with gusset waste
resolved.summary: The hose had gusset waste stuck inside at 12:48, causing a brief stoppage while the operator cleared it.

resolved.title: ML3 line down for CIL intervention
resolved.summary: Line stopped for 5 minutes to address a CIL issue, then restarted immediately.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:43 — "We are running again" (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML4 ingredient tank 2 pump clogged
resolved.summary: Tank 2 making noise and not sending cream to depositor 3 at 04:44; line paused at 05:48 when pump confirmed clogged.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:09 — "Issue is fixed, we filling up depositor 3 to start" at 06:01, then "Running" at 06:09 (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: ML4 TG3 belts slipping on low tension
resolved.summary: TG3 down at 06:58, blowing all bars to discharge; maintenance found belts didn't have enough tension and were slipping.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:18 — "It was working properly the belts didn't have enough tension and were slipping" (Nelson Cook).

resolved.title: Chocolate aligner malfunction on truffle line
resolved.summary: Flow wrapper had problems with the chocolate aligner at 07:15; maintenance was already working on it when reported.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:12 — "Settings have been adjusted accordingly and it's now working as should" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: Truffle line guillotine belt stopped from dirt buildup
resolved.summary: Belt stopped at 11:03, maintenance called; cleaning revealed the belt was dirty enough to cause the stoppage after only 5 hours of runtime.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:15 — "The belt was dirty once it was cleaned it started to work again" and "The line is running again" (Nelson Cook, Grey Boscan).

needs_attention.title: S4 THG fingers bent and belts misaligned
needs_attention.summary: Fingers on the Theegarten are bent and separating belt and guillotine belts not aligned, causing inconsistent piece size; maintenance working on it.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance adjusted rails at 10:33 which were misaligned; no clear confirmation that finger bending or all alignment issues fully resolved.

needs_attention.title: S3 kitchen filter hose clogged from unwashed piping
needs_attention.summary: The filter hose on line 3 kitchen wasn't washed and became clogged; operator notes this happens when internal piping isn't washed properly.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 05:19 with photos; no resolution message logged.

needs_attention.title: S4 belt installed incorrectly, left on outside
needs_attention.summary: Kitchen tablet reported the belt wasn't installed correctly at shift start and was left on the outside; no follow-up logged.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 05:22; no resolution or follow-up message in the window.

needs_attention.title: S3 kitchen C1 front panel won't close
needs_attention.summary: Maintenance needed to reset the program on Kitchen 3 unit C1 because the front panel won't close.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 05:58; no maintenance response logged in window.

needs_attention.title: S2 mixing tank A heavy cream valve gasket leaking
needs_attention.summary: The gasket on the heavy cream valve for mixing tank A is leaking and needs replacement according to the enrober operator.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 06:58; no maintenance response or repair logged by window close.

needs_attention.title: FFS line down for blade cleaning
needs_attention.summary: Line went down at 13:11 to clean the blade; operator posted a photo but no restart message appears in the window.
needs_attention.status: Down at 13:11 for blade cleaning; no "running" message by window close at 15:59.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line guillotine belt worn scrapers and peeling
needs_attention.summary: Belt stopped again at 15:11; maintenance found scrapers worn or improperly positioned removing too much chocolate, and the belt began peeling from the inner side by 15:53.
needs_attention.status: Began chocolate deposition process at 15:42 per 15:57 message, but scraper wear and belt peeling noted 15:23-15:53 remain unresolved at window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG5 FW not cutting properly, sending linked bars
needs_attention.summary: TG5 down at 08:15 with flow wrapper not cutting properly and sending bars in a link; issue persisted on and off all day despite adjustments.
needs_attention.status: Tech adjusted upper bracket at 15:47 saying it was fixed, but unclear if fully resolved; line ran steady after mid-shift per 12:35 update.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG4 adjustments in progress at shift end
needs_attention.summary: Line stopped temporarily at 15:54 for tech to make adjustments on TG4 and TG5; TG5 came back up but TG4 still being adjusted at 15:57.
needs_attention.status: TG5 up and running at 15:57, but TG4 still being adjusted by tech as of last message at window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 preheating 3 has fused bulb
needs_attention.summary: Preheating unit 3 has one fused bulb that needs replacement according to the operator.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 09:28; no maintenance response or bulb replacement logged.
